cues: Climb from a village to a hilltop.
Take the steep direct path, or the long winding trail.
The height you gain is the same either way: it depends only on where you start and end.
The distance you walk depends on the route.
text: Climb from a village to a hilltop. Take the steep direct path, or the long winding trail. The height you gain is the same either way: it depends only on where you start and end. The distance you walk depends on the route.
